notes.title: New content for Effie on Steam!
notes.content:
Hey dear travelers of Oblena!

We've just released new content for Effie on Steam, which includes:
[list]
[*] 7x Trading Cards
[*] 6x Badges
[*] 4x Profile Backgrounds

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33890535/a8660977dd3fb7cccc7a7f22b0df76a334ada71b.png[/img]

Gotta catch 'em all! ːgalandshieldː

notes.title: A 3D action and platforming adventure arrives in 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33890535/86524f6c83b505ab0c11ffc8977f709436116497.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

It's a pleasure for Inverge Studios to present Effie, a 3D platforming adventure that will reach the platform in 2019.

[h1]What is Effie?[/h1]
Effie is an action-adventure game that combines classic elements from the genre, such as combat, platforming, and puzzles, with the exploration of an expanded world.

[h1]Action, adventure, platform, combat, puzzles...[/h1]
Yes! This probably brings you some nostalgia... because it sounds like old school! Memories of those classic console games that we enjoyed so much and spent so many hours in.

Effie is a new story, with modern graphics and a gameplay that feels comfortable. In it we will control Galand, a man who has been cursed with premature old age, and who will have to make up for lost time.

And he will try indeed... fighting with his shield!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WK3MBwn/Combate-Defensa-Small256.gif[/img]

[h1]Do you want to know more?[/h1]
If you want to keep up to date and not miss anything of this new adventure, do not hesitate! Add the game to your wishlist, subscribe to the game newsletter, keep an eye on the news and get ready for lots of action and fun!

[b]Effie will be out this 2019![/b] ːsteamhappyː
